source: 619 Chronicles
target: 619 Chronicae

source: Franca strained her eyes, attempting to discern the figure amidst the dimly lit surroundings.
target: Franca oculos strenue conigit, figuram inter obscurum lumen circumdantium discernere conante.

source: The tall buildings loomed mysteriously, their outlines blending with the fog, reminiscent of stars reflecting on a foggy night.
target: Aedificia alta mysterio apparabantur, lineamenta eorum cum nebula miscebantur, quasi stellae in nocte nebulosa reflexae.

source: In the distance, lights flickered, accompanied by indistinct honking sounds.
target: In longinquo lumina micabant, comitantur sonitus tubarum inconfusi.

source: Wh… Franca’s pupils dilated, and her eyes widened in astonishment.
target: Ecce… pupillae Francae dilatatae sunt, et oculi eius stupore expansae.

source: Her heart, previously gripped by the effects of Naboredisley’s frenzied curse, now surged with shock.
target: Cor eius, olim captum effectibus maledicti furoris Naboredisley, nunc subito pertonitum excitatum est.

source: Instinctively, she focused all her might on the figure, trying to pierce through the layers of gray fog and unravel its face and clothing.
target: Instinctu totam potentiam suam in figuram intendit, conans per stratos nebulae grisea penetrare atque eius faciem ac vestimenta explicare.

source: However, the thin fog grew hazier, dissipating along with the fleeting images it carried.
target: Attamen, tenuis nebula magis opaca facta est, evanescens cum imaginibus labilibus quas portabat.

source: In just three to four seconds, the mirror on the altar reverted to its normal state.
target: In tantis tribus ad quattuor secundis, speculum in altare ad statum suum normalem rediit.

source: “What’s wrong?” Lumian turned to Flores, who lingered in the residual gray fog, seeking an update on Franca’s condition.
target: “Quid accidit?” Lumian ad Flores conversus est, qui in nebula grise residuali remansabat, quaerens de statu Francae nuntium.

source: Franca, still captivated by the mirror, fell silent for a moment before speaking.
target: Franca, adhuc speculo captata, momento silentium cepit antequam loqui inciperet.

source: “Did you see the scene reflected in the mirror?”
target: “Vidistine scaenam in speculo reflexam?”

source: “I did.” Lumian reflected briefly and suggested, “Perhaps it signifies Mr. Fool’s divine kingdom.”
target: “Vidi.” Lumian breviter meditatus est et proposuit, “Forsitan significat regnum divinum Domini Stulti.”

source: Their prayers for the Exorcism Spell had been directed towards Mr. Fool.
target: Precationes eorum pro Incantatione Exorcismi ad Dominum Stultum directae erant.

source: Therefore, the mirror used to deceive Naboredisley while being ineffective in actuality was likely related to Mr. Fool.
target: Itaque, speculum ad decipiendum Naboredisley usitatum, dum re vera inefficax erat, verisimiliter ad Dominum Stultum pertinuit.

source: Franca stammered, “B-but the backdrop resembles the city before your sister and I transmigrated.
target: Franca balbutiens dixit, “M–mē tamen scaena postica urbi similis est antequam soror tua et ego translati essemus.

source: It’s like those foggy times—every building morphing into colossal creatures nestled in the fog, adorned with countless glowing eyes.
target: Similis est illis temporibus nebularum—omnia aedificia in ingentes creaturas in nebula collocatas mutare videntur, ornata oculis innumerabilibus fulgentibus.

source: Lumian, understanding Franca’s emotions, showed no surprise at the familiar street scenes.
target: Lumian, affectus Francae intellegens, nullam admirationem pro consuetis scaenis viarum ostendit.

source: Reminding his companion, he said, “Don’t forget about the Celestial Worthy.
target: Socii suo admonens dixit, “Noli oblivisci de Celestiali Digno.

source: He has a close connection to your homeland, and he and Mr. Fool have been engaged in a dream battle.
target: Ille arctam relationem cum patria tua habet, et ipse atque Dominus Stultus in pugna somniorum versati sunt.

source: It’s quite conceivable that such dreamscapes can manifest in reality through rituals.
target: Plenissime fieri potest ut talia spectacula somniorum per ritus in rem manifestentur.

source: Franca fell into a momentary silence before releasing a sigh.
target: Franca in silentium momento cecidit antequam suspirum emitteret.

source: “You’re right…”
target: “Recte dicis…”

source: She followed with a self-deprecating laugh.
target: Deinde risu auto-despectivo se commituit.

source: “I got worked up for nothing.”
target: “Pro nihilo commota sum.”

source: Lumian mitigated the negative effects from Naboredisley and methodically extinguished the candle flames, concluding the ritual.
target: Lumian effectus negativos a Naboredisley lenivit et flammas candelae methodice exstinxit, ritum concludens.

source: As Franca dispelled the wall of spirituality and the wind howled, clearing away the lingering gray fog, Flores seemed to snap back to reality, no longer lost in the confusion of searching for an exit.
target: Dum Franca murum spiritualitatis dissolvit et ventus ululabat, nebulam grise remanentem tollens, Flores ad rem revocari videbatur, iam non in confusione exitus quaerendi perditus.

source: However, upon seeing Lumian and Franca, his face turned an even more pallid shade.
target: Attamen, Lumianem et Francam videns, vultus eius etiam pallidior factus est.

source: Just as he was about to plead for mercy, a sharp pain shot through Flores’s body.
target: Iam cum misericordiam petere pararetur, acuta dolor per corpus Flores transeat.

source: Instinctively, he lowered his head and observed a black, almost ethereal, filthy liquid oozing from his body.
target: Instinctive, caput inclinavit et observavit liquidum atrum, paene aethericum, immundum ex corpore suo effluere.

source: Highly corrosive, it swiftly dissolved his blood, flesh, and bones.
target: Valde corrosivum, celeriter sanguinem, carnem, et ossa eius dissolvit.

source: “No!
target: “Non!

source: “Save me!
target: “Salva me!

source: “Save me!”
target: “Salva me!”

source: Flores unleashed a blood-curdling scream, repeatedly calling for help.
target: Flores clamorem terribilem edidit, iterum atque iterum auxilium vocans.

source: Lumian, however, observed with interest, as though studying the toll exacted on those who made a deal with Demons.
target: Lumian, attamen, cum studio contemplatus est, quasi poenam in iis qui pacto cum Daemoniis consenserunt spectans.

source: In less than ten seconds, Flores’s body succumbed to corrosion, collapsing with a resounding crash, immersed in the almost illusory black liquid.
target: In minus quam decem secundis, corpus Flores corrosioni cedere coepit, magno strepitu corruens, imerso in liquido nigro paene illusorio.

source: Flores’s head continued to wail, his voice gradually fading.
target: Caput Flores ululans perseverabat, vox eius paulatim evanescens.

source: After a while, he breathed his last with wide-open eyes.
target: Post aliquod tempus, ultimum spiritum egit cum oculis lati apertis.

source: His relatively intact head swiftly disintegrated into the filthy liquid.
target: Caput eius, relative intactum, celeriter in liquidum immundum dissolutum est.

source: The once-illusory liquid lost its evil, mystical aura, revealing the remains of the corpse, now filled with a foul, noxious mud-like substance.
target: Liquor, olim illusorius, maleficam et mysticam auram amisit, reliquias cadaveris revelans, nunc foetido luti instar substantia repletum ostendens.

source: “Dealing with Demons doesn’t end well..” Franca sighed, reflecting on her earlier temptation.
target: “Negotium cum Daemoniis bene finiendum non videtur…” Franca suspiravit, de priore tentatione cogitans.

source: Her laughter echoed hollowly as she continued, “Thankfully, we didn’t strike a deal with that self-proclaimed ancient Demon.
target: Risus eius caviter resonabat cum prosequeretur, “Benedictione, pactum non fecimus cum illo veteri Daemone seipso declarato.

source: Still, I missed an opportunity to eliminate the latent threat of using the Authority Holder’s Under-the-table Transaction.
target: Attamen, occasionem amisi latentem minas ex usu Transactionis Sub-tabulum Possessoris Auctoritatis tollendi.

source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “Consider this carefully.
target: Lumian subridens dixit, “Hoc diligenter considera.

source: “I remember Madam Magician’s usage instructions, emphasizing the possibility of encountering transactions with evil entities like Demons.
target: Memini praecepta usus Dominae Magicae, quae possibilitatem occurrence transactionum cum malis entibus, ut Daemoniis, extollere solebant.

source: “Recall, it was about encountering a transaction, not completing one.
target: Memento, de occurrence transactionis erat, non de eam perficienda.

source: “You’ve faced it; you simply chose not to accept it. That fellow didn’t force you either.”
target: Id expertus es; simpliciter nolivisti accipere, nec ille te compelluit.

source: Franca contemplated the situation and admitted, “You make a point. It does seem that way…”
target: Franca rem consideravit et confessa est, “Recte dicis. Ita videtur…”

source: She clicked her tongue and glanced at Lumian.
target: Lingua pulsans et ad Lumian intuentis.

source: “If you had chosen the Lawyer path, you might be equally promising…
target: “Si viam Advocati elegisses, aeque potens forsitan fuisset…

source: “In reality, I believe that’s the norm. The Authority Holder’s Under-the-table Transaction is, at most, equivalent to a Sequence 5.
target: “Revera, hoc esse normam credo. Transactionis Sub-tabulum Possessoris Auctoritatis, saltem, aequivalens est ad Sequenciam V.

source: Every use means one less opportunity. How could the negative effects be a transaction with a Demon?
target: Quot usus, una minor occasio significatur. Quomodo effectus negativos transactioni cum Daemone esse possint?

source: From what I know, Demon is a High Sequence term within the Criminal path. What does it signify? It represents a demigod!
target: Ex his quae scio, Daemon terminus altus est in via Criminali. Quid significat? Imago semidei repraesentat!

source: “Yes, it’s merely encountering a transaction, not completing it. There’s room for negotiation. Yet, it’s also highly dangerous.
target: “Ita quidem, tantum transactio incidit, non perficiatur. Locus ad tractandum est; sed simul summopere periculosum est.

source: Demons and other evil entities aren’t known for their philanthropy.
target: Daemones atque alia mala entia pro philanthropia nota non sunt.

source: If we refuse to trade with them, why would they spare us indefinitely?
target: Si commercium cum illis neglegimus, cur nobis in aeternum parcere conarentur?

source: Furthermore, predicting when we’ll encounter them is impossible, making it challenging to prepare in advance.
target: Praeterea, praedicere quandocumque eos occursuros simus impossibile est, quod praeparationem difficilius reddit.

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridens.

source: “If you can’t predict it, try approaching it differently.
target: “Si id praedicere non potes, alia ratione aditum age.

source: After using the Authority Holder’s Under-the-table Transaction, immediately prepare and take the initiative to create an opportunity to negotiate with Demons and other evil creatures.
target: Post usum Transactionis Sub-tabulum Possessoris Auctoritatis, statim para et incipe ad occasionem creandam ad tractationem cum Daemoniis aliisque malis creaturis.

source: Set the pace and manage the risks.
target: Celeritatem constitui et pericula regere.

source: For instance, ‘invite’ Demons to Saint Viève Cathedral for a deal.
target: Exempli gratia, Daemones ad Basilica Sanctae Viève “invida” ad pactum.

source: The Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s main cathedral in Trier, Saint Viève Cathedral!
target: Principalissima basilica Ecclesiae Aeternae Solis Flammantis in Treviris, Basilica Sanctae Viève!

source: Franca chuckled.
target: Franca risum edidit.

source: “Demons aren’t brainless zombies. Why would they willingly walk into Saint Viève Cathedral to meet their doom…”
target: “Daemones non sunt zombii sine ratione. Cur enim voluntarie in Basilica Sanctae Viève ingrediantur ut fatum suum experirentur…”

source: Franca suddenly halted.
target: Franca subito sistit.

source: Saint Viève Cathedral might not be suitable, but they did have a few hidden locations with a similar atmosphere.
target: Basilica Sanctae Viève forsitan non apta sit, sed pauca loca abscondita cum simili atmosphaera habebantur.

source: It wasn’t entirely impossible.
target: Non plane impossibilia erant.

source: For example, the sacrificial square on the third level of the catacombs, Krismona Night Pillar…
target: Exempli gratia, forum sacrificii in tertio gradu catacumbarum, Columna Noctis Krismonae…

source: “That’s an interesting idea,” Franca commended Lumian.
target: “Illud praeclarum consilium est,” Franca Lumiano laudavit.

source: “In the past, when facing the negative effects of mystical items, we always endured and waited passively.
target: "In pristinis temporibus, cum effectibus negativis rerum mysticarum obviessemus, semper sustinui-mus et passive exspectavimus.

source: Taking the initiative is a different approach. Hunters indeed have their own unique styles.
target: Inceptum agendi alius modus est. Venatores vere proprias ac singulares rationes habent.

source: Taking the initiative involved making preparations in advance and minimizing potential dangers.
target: Inchoare operam significabat praeparations ante omnia facere atque pericula potentialia minuere.

source: Of course, taking the initiative didn’t necessarily mean triggering the effects, but it required considering such possibilities.
target: Scilicet, inceptum agendi non necessario significat effectus excitare, sed talia considerare oportet.

source: Lumian glanced out the window.
target: Lumian per fenestram intueri.

source: “Flores’s scream has likely attracted the attention of the nearby residents.
target: “Clamor Flores probabiliter attentionem incolarum vicinorum attulit.

source: Someone may have called the police.
target: Aliquis fortasse vigilum cohortem vocavit.

source: Let’s vacate this place before examining the contents of this notebook.
target: Eamus hic exire antequam codicis huius substantiam inspiciamus.

source: He gathered the ancient notebook, candles, and other items from the dining table as he spoke.
target: Ille codicem antiquam, candelas, et alias res ex mensa convivii congregavit dum loquebatur.

source: “Agreed.” Franca surveyed the room, and dark flames silently ignited in various spots.
target: “Consentitum.” Franca conclave inspiciens, et obscurae flammae silentio in diversis locis accenderunt.

source: As the flames flickered, Lumian teleported Franca away, returning to the guest room of Captain Pedro’s five-story house.
target: Dum flammae micabantur, Lumian Francam teletransportavit, rediens ad conclave hospitum domus capitanei Pedri quinque tabulata.

source: “Go through the notebook and check if there’s a way to dispel the love incantation.
target: “Perlege codicem atque vide an via sit incantationem amoris exstingui.

source: I’ll verify Salah’s condition and inform Pedro about Flores’s situation and outcome.
target: Statu Salah confirmabo et Pedrum certiorem faciam de re Flores atque eius eventu.

source: He can handle the Church of Earth Mother and liaise with the local police.”
target: Ipse curabit de Ecclesia Matris Terrae et cum vigilibus localibus consulabit.

source: Lumian handed the ancient notebook to Franca before opening the door and stepping into the corridor.
target: Lumian codicem antiquam Francae tradidit antequam ostium aperiret et in vestibulum ingredierit.

source: Franca settled into the recliner and opened the notebook.
target: Franca in solio reclinatorio consedit et codicem aperuit.

source: Suddenly, she murmured to herself, Something feels off.
target: Subito sibi murmurat, “Aliquid male videtur.”

source: Knowing Lumian’s approach, shouldn’t he have immediately perused the notebook after the ritual, searching for a solution to dispel the love incantation?
target: Lumiani consilium notum, num statim post ritum codicem perlegere debuisset, quaerens solutionem incantationis amoris exstingui?

source: Why did he hastily leave the moment the police were mentioned after discussing matters with me extensively?
target: Cur celeriter discessit in ipso momento quo de vigilibus dicta sunt postquam de rebus mecum plene disseruimus?

source: He should be aware of the critical issue…
target: Scire debet rem magni momenti…

source: As these thoughts raced through her mind, Franca suddenly came to a moment of realization.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabantur, Franca subito ad revelationem pervenit.

source: Naboredisley’s chilling rants and wild curses had a disturbing impact on Lumian, stirring up his desires and emotions.
target: Eroca verba terrifica atque ferocia maledicta Naboredisley in Lumiano perturbationem intulerunt, desideria atque affectus excitantes.

source: Despite his attempts to endure the onslaught using his Ascetic powers, subtle signs of struggle manifested.
target: Quamquam impetum tolerare conatus est utens viribus asceticis, subtilia signa certaminis manifeste apparuerunt.

source: Franca’s eyes darted around, a sly chuckle escaping her lips.
target: Oculi Francae circumvolitabant, subdolus risus labris eius effugiens.

source: Lumian found Pedro in the small living room on the first floor.
target: Lumian Pedrum invenit in parva triclinio primo tabulato.

source: Before he could delve into Flores’s situation, the captain exclaimed in surprise,
target: Priusquam de re Flores penetrare posset, capitaneus miratus exclamavit,

source: “Mr. Berry, Salah came to me a few minutes ago.
target: “Domine Berry, Salah mihi paucos minuta antevenit.

source: She was crying in fear and pain, saying she dreamt of falling in love with Flores and couldn’t wake up.
target: Flebat metu et dolore, dicens se somniasse amorem Flores atque excitari non posse.

source: However, she suddenly woke up tonight, feeling like it was a nightmare, and she wishes to annul the engagement.
target: Attamen, hac nocte subito expergefacta est, sensu quasi horrendo somnio, atque pactum dissolvere velle.

source: “May I know how you did it?”
target: “Licet scire quomodo id feceris?”

source: Pedro spoke with a touch of unconscious politeness.
target: Pedro cum levitate inconsciae urbanitatis loquebatur.

source: She’s back to normal? Could it be because Flores is dead?
target: “Rediit ad statum normalem? Forsitan quia Flores mortuus est?”

source: No, more likely Naboredisley’s expulsion through the Exorcism Spell has restored those affected by the devil to normal…
target: “Non; magis verisimile est exorcismi incantatione Naboredisley eos, qui a diabolo affecti erant, ad statum normalem restituisse…”

source: Lumian guessed, smiling.
target: Lumian suspicatus est, subridens.

source: “Flores is already dead.”
target: “Flores iam mortuus est.”

source: “Did you kill him?” Pedro, showing no aversion to the idea of killing, was even more intrigued by the fact that Flores’s death seemed to have awakened his daughter.
target: “Num eum occidisti?” Pedro, nullam repugnationem ad caedem ostendens, etiam magis admiratus est quod mors Flores filiam eius excitasse videbatur.

source: “A Demon killed him.” Lumian briefly recounted the events, avoiding mentioning Naboredisley by name.
target: “Daemon eum occidit.” Lumian brevius eventus narravit, nomen Naboredisley vitans.

source: Instead, he handed Pedro the love incantation note tucked into an ancient notebook for a closer look.
target: Pro eo, tradidit Pedro notam incantationis amoris in antiquo codice inclusam ad propiorem recognitionem.

source: Finally, he said, “You handle the rest. It’s advisable to keep Salah in a cathedral or cloister for the next month or two.
target: Denique dixit, “Restum tu curabis. Consulendum est Salah in basilica aut claustro retinere per proximos unum vel duo menses.

source: I'm uncertain if the Demon will revisit the former victim once he recovers.”
target: Nescio an daemon pristinum victimam, postquam se sanaverit, iterum visitabit.

source: “Understood.” Pedro clenched his teeth, his expression somber.
target: “Intellectum.” Pedro dentes contraxit, vultu graviter affecto.

source: After receiving the 20,000 gold risot bounty, Lumian returned to his guest room.
target: Postquam praemium 20,000 aureorum risot accepit, Lumian ad conclave hospitum rediit.

source: Franca, holding the ancient notebook, frowned as she said, “This doesn’t seem like the notebook of an evil Warlock.
target: Franca, codicem antīquum tenens, fronte contrasta dixit, “Hoc non videtur esse codex maligni Magi.

source: It’s more like a collection of a novelty hunter’s chronicles.
target: Potissimum videtur esse congeries chronicarum venatoris novitatis.

source: It contains various legends of Devils and Demons from the Northern and Southern Continents spanning the past thousand years.
target: Continet varias legendas de Diabolis et Daemoniis ex Continente Septentrionali et Meridionali per milia annorum praeteritorum.

source: The last record appears to be over a hundred years ago.
target: Ultimum documentum videtur esse plus quam centum annos abhinc.

source: “Mmm… There are peculiar incantations scattered within, as if fabricated.
target: “Mmm… incantationes peculiares intra dispersae videntur, quasi fictae.

source: “One of them mentions a legend of a Demon on Hanth Island in the Berserk Sea.”
target: Una earum memorat legendam de Daemone in Insula Hanth in Mari Frenetico.

source: Lumian grasped Franca’s concern.
target: Lumian sollicitationem Francae comprehendere sensit.

source: Naboredisley had mentioned that the Demon descendant he sought to eliminate resided somewhere in the Berserk Sea!
target: Naboredisley memoraverat Daemoni generis quem exstinguere quaerebat aliquo in Mari Frenetico habitare!
